title: Battle of Shanhaiguan (1900)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Shanhaiguan (1900)", at revision 1370589172, opens: "The Battle of Shanhaiguan took place in 1900 when Qing dynasty imperial troops and the Boxers engaged in combat against British forces." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4188868, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1900 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
